{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Overloaded Day 1 visits with multiple PROs and labs",
      "quote": "PRO/QOL assessments: FACT-G GP5 and PRO- CTCAE",
      "page": 31,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Each treatment cycle Day 1 includes multiple PROs (FACT-G, PRO-CTCAE, BPI, QLQ-C, QLQ-LC, EQ-5D-5L) plus labs and vital signs, creating high patient burden and potential for incomplete data.",
      "fix": "Consider staggering PROs across visits or reducing frequency of some instruments."
    },
    {
      "title": "ECG only at screening, missing on-treatment assessments",
      "quote": "ECG | X |  |  |  |  |  |",
      "page": 31,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "ECG is only performed at screening, but safety monitoring for QT changes typically requires on-treatment ECGs, especially with docetaxel.",
      "fix": "Add ECG at specified on-treatment timepoints."
    },
    {
      "title": "Coagulation only at screening and SFU, not on-treatment",
      "quote": "Coagulation | X |  |  |  |  | X |",
      "page": 31,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Coagulation is not assessed during treatment, which may miss bleeding or thrombotic events related to therapy.",
      "fix": "Add coagulation at least once during treatment."
    },
    {
      "title": "CT/MRI only at screening, no on-treatment tumor assessment",
      "quote": "CT/MRIf | X |  |  |  |  |  |",
      "page": 31,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "No tumor imaging is scheduled during treatment or follow-up, making it impossible to assess efficacy endpoints.",
      "fix": "Add scheduled tumor assessments at specified intervals."
    },
    {
      "title": "PGIC only at Cycle 3, not at baseline",
      "quote": "PRO/QOL assessments: PGIC |  |  |  | X |  |  |",
      "page": 31,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "PGIC measures change from baseline, but no baseline PGIS is collected at Cycle 3; PGIS is only at screening and Cycle 1, making interpretation difficult.",
      "fix": "Align PGIS and PGIC timepoints or add baseline PGIS at Cycle 3."
    },
    {
      "title": "Cholesterol and Triglyceride not at baseline",
      "quote": "Cholesterol and Triglyceride |  | X |  | X |  | X |",
      "page": 31,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Lipid panel is not collected at screening, so baseline values are missing for comparison.",
      "fix": "Add lipid panel to screening assessments."
    },
    {
      "title": "Concomitant medication only at screening, not updated",
      "quote": "Concomitant medication | X |  |  |  |  |  |",
      "page": 31,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Concomitant medications are only recorded at screening, but changes during treatment are critical for safety and drug interaction monitoring.",
      "fix": "Collect concomitant medications at each visit."
    },
    {
      "title": "Vital signs at LTFU but no other assessments",
      "quote": "Vital Assessment |  |  |  |  |  |  | X",
      "page": 31,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Long-term follow-up only includes vital signs, but no survival or disease status is collected, limiting long-term outcome data.",
      "fix": "Add survival status and disease assessment to LTFU."
    }
  ]
}
